## Validation

- [ ] Rust tests, Clippy and formatting
- [ ] Android unit tests and APK build
- [ ] Device/emulator tests (describe devices, or explain why unavailable)
- [ ] CI passes for this exact commit
- [ ] Documentation updated

## Decentralisation and security

- [ ] No centralised service, relay, hosted discovery, push gateway or hosted message store added
- [ ] Identity and pinned-key verification preserved
- [ ] Network inputs remain bounded and malformed input is rejected
- [ ] No private keys, tokens or personal data added to logs or fixtures
- [ ] No unsupported claims of production security or cross-platform interoperability
